info.privacy.title: Notice for workers
info.privacy.body: Notice for workers – Aloni. Data controller: {controller_name}, {controller_address}, phone {controller_phone}. We record your name, your role, your e-mail if you have an account, a technical identifier of your device, optionally your phone number, and the jobs you enter (sprays, harvest, observations). The purpose is to organise the work and to keep the plant-protection records the law requires. The legal basis is your employment contract and a legal obligation. Your phone number is optional: if you give it, the basis is your consent and you may withdraw it at any time. We do not track your location. Data is processed on our behalf by Supabase (servers in Frankfurt, EU) and Cloudflare (delivering the app). [To be checked by a lawyer: whether any data is transferred outside the EU.] Spray records are kept for at least 3 years, as the law requires. Other data is deleted when the working relationship ends. You have the right of access, correction, deletion where permitted, and to complain to the Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
info.disclaimer.title: Decision support, not a prescription
info.disclaimer.body: What the app shows is decision support only. It is not a prescription or agronomic advice. For every plant protection product, the agronomist's prescription and the product label apply. The decision to apply a product, and responsibility for it, rest with you, the user who applies it, not with the app.
